title: MissingInfoBuildingPosition
description: Contract for the Stage 1 Brain Completion Batch, Phase 2 — the building-position missing-information rule. Output is a plain string|null, not the {text,category,discipline} object shape used by runStage1Risks() rules. Contract version 1.0.0.

input.description: The raw p.facts.buildingPositionStatus value. Inequality against 'confirmed'.

output.description: The fixed missing-info text, or null when buildingPositionStatus === 'confirmed'.

oneOf.const: Building position not yet confirmed on a site map.
